jub.role: ballet artist (coryphée 2nd rank); acting assistant régisseur of the ballet from 1886
jub.dates: 25 years, 19 November 1892 (service counted from 19 November 1867); born SP 19 November 1851

jub.evidence_english: on 19 November 1892 A. M. Kamyshev completed 25 years of service to the choreographic art
jub.notes: [Printed as a stand-alone article, not under a Юбилеи/Некрологи heading; occasion: a jubilee.] Heading verbatim: «Александръ Михайловичъ Камышевъ.»; subtitle verbatim: «(По поводу 25-ти-лѣтія его сценической дѣятельности).»; oval portrait flanked «XXV» / «XXV». Staged dances in drama, e.g. the German plays «Drei Monat nach Dato» and «Pech-Schultze». No roles or ballets named.
